Authentic worn rubber black body and aged plastic, quiet subdued light, detailed tactile realism. No other devices, loose accessories, hands, logos, branding, numerals, labels, printed letters, UI or watermark. Antenna entirely in frame. Concrete background very dark and unobtrusive. Use a clear unambiguous LCD and button shape for precise HTML overlays.
